items.provider: Gemini API - image input token count (1920x1080 / 1080p)
items.tier_notes: Page gives: images with both dimensions <= 384 px cost 258 tokens; larger images are tiled into 768x768 tiles, each 258 tokens. The page does not state a 1080p figure and describes a crop-unit tile-count formula that was not fully extracted. A simple ceil(1920/768) x ceil(1080/768) = 3 x 2 = 6 tiles x 258 = 1,548 tokens is an unverified estimate, not confirmed by the page. Image tokens are not separately priced on the pricing page, so the per-1M input rate above is the basis for cost.
items.quote: "258 tokens if both dimensions <= 384 pixels." "Larger images are tiled into 768x768 pixel tiles, each costing 258 tokens."
